AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Upcoming is a scheduling app. The signed-in user is the meeting host; attendees book meetings on the user's public booking page. Operational Patterns: - Use 'listEventTypes' to discover the user's bookable meeting types and their ids. - Use 'checkAvailability' before sharing a time, and 'getUpcomingBookings' or 'getBooking' to answer questions about scheduled meetings. - Use 'createSingleUseBookingLink' to mint a one-time booking link and share the returned url with the invitee. - Use 'getPersonalShareLink' when the user wants to share their booking page rather than a single meeting type. Constraints: - Every function requires the user to be signed in to Upcoming; if not, ask them to sign in first. - The user is always the host; never offer to book meetings on their behalf.
